en: “Here we go again... Why are you always so damn nervous around me?”
Ever since that time she sucked me off, I always try to avoid Ayano whenever possible.
Even I question if it was real or not.
But all I know is that image and the tingling sensation... I can't forget it.
If I don't consciously avoid it, every time I see her, it's so damn easy to...
“Why are you covering down there? You hiding something?”
“Why do you have batteries in your pocket?”
“Don't tell me you were awake that night—?”
“Is there anything I can improve on?”
“Ever since you came, Kasumi's load has lightened a lot.”
Ayano is like a kid, happily savoring the candy in her mouth.
Without meaning to, I still find myself glancing at her lips.
Not sure what Ayano is thinking, I silently follow her suggestion and sit down right on the hallway floor.
Ayano suddenly hugs me from behind, pressing her body tightly against my back.
And of course, I can fully feel her ample chest.
“Hey, don't you get lonely coming here all by yourself?”
“I know it's for work and paying off debts, but being away from friends or a lover must be boring, right?”
“And why do you have so much debt at only 20?”
“It's nothing... just got sold out by my parents.”
“It was originally my parents' debt, but I woke up one day to a table full of debt papers with my fingerprints on them.”
“Before that, I was just busting my ass working, so I didn't really have close friends, let alone a lover.”
“All thanks to Shizuko, she's helped me a lot.”
“I was able to come here, and even though it hasn't been long, I've been pretty happy these past few days.”
“Hehe, there's a lot more happy stuff to come.”
“To make sure you're satisfied with my work, I'm willing to do anything for you, anything.”
“See, you want to get up and run away now, don't you?”
“It's because you're, you know, clinging too tight—!”
“It's... bad, it's bad, it's really bad!”
Ayano suddenly brings her face close, breathing in my ear.
“...You were awake that night, weren't you?”
“Okay, okay, just kidding—Your reaction is way too intense though, hahaha—”
“But you still need to relax occasionally—if you know what I mean?”
“Otherwise, you'll be crushed, body and soul.”
“Hehe, okay then—I've got to head to church next, so I'm off, bye!”
Watching Ayano walk away, I let out a long sigh.
“Guess I was found out after all, huh...”
